routes.label: Count the decreases and include the starting number

question: When counting from \(3\) to \(201,\) the number \(53\) is in position \(51.\) When counting backward from \(201\) to \(3,\) the number \(53\) is in position \(n.\) What is \(n?\)
solution:
Counting backward from \(201\) to \(53\) requires \(201-53=148\) decreases by \(1\). The starting number \(201\) already occupies position \(1\), so the position of \(53\) is
\[
n=148+1=\boxed{149}.
\]
The answer is \(\text{D}\).
